invariants.text: Membership, ancestry and routing do not create Resolution Authority in another Context.
An export alone never changes target-local state and never authorizes an effect.
Every accepted import observation begins as Seed semantic status UNKNOWN with enforcement BLOCKED.
Recognition requires an exact target-local Seed resolution binding and a terminal ACCEPT or DENY.
Target enforcement is ALLOW only for target-local ACCEPT; UNKNOWN and DENY remain BLOCKED.
Route, export, import and recognition preserve exact source, target, scope and policy-epoch bindings.
Every active route has two distinct active member Contexts.
A member may withdraw only after every route involving it is suspended.
Federation and metafederation composition does not imply a superior Context or inherited Authority.

Every accepted canonical network transition appends exactly one digest to the canonical evidence history; previously committed history entries are immutable. The evidence history does not itself confer Authority or alter transition eligibility except where an explicit normative rule refers to a prior transition.
An exact replay is idempotent; a conflicting reuse of an identifier is rejected.
This extension may strengthen but may not weaken the pinned ASET Seed invariants.

defines: bounded route grants between active Contexts
binding of imported artifacts to target-local ASET Seed resolution cycles
conditional liveness under explicit fairness and environment assumptions

principles.text: Each Context retains its own Constitution, Authority, canonical state and local recognition of Outcome.
Federation membership and Context ancestry create no Authority inheritance.
A cross-context export is evidence presented to the target Context, not a decision binding the target Context.
A federation or metafederation is a composition relation and never a superior Context by implication.

requirements.text: Implementations MUST expose deterministic observable results for every conformance case.
Implementations MUST reject cross-context effects not backed by target-local ACCEPT.
Implementations MUST bind all route and recognition operations to exact Context IDs, scope digests and policy epochs.
Implementations MUST retain provenance linking recognition to export, import observation and Seed resolution.
Implementations MUST publish operational security and durability guarantees separately.
Implementations claiming ASET-NETWORK-LIVENESS-V1 MUST declare which liveness assumptions they satisfy and MUST NOT present conditional progress as an unconditional transport guarantee.
Formal assurance MUST preserve the distinction between target-local resolution progress and the substantive result ACCEPT or DENY.

Core ASET Network Extension conformance MUST NOT require an ASET-NETWORK-LIVENESS-V1 claim. An implementation making that optional claim MUST declare the assumptions it relies on and the guarantees it claims under those assumptions.

state.history: canonical append-only accepted-transition evidence digest sequence
state.recognitions: RecognitionID -> target-local terminal Seed result receipt

state_partition.transition_enabling_rule: Evidence history MUST NOT itself confer Authority or alter transition eligibility unless an explicit normative rule refers to a prior transition.
